outcome: Risk factors for atonic postpartum hemorrhage
cohort: 383 women with atonic postpartum hemorrhage and 383 matched controls without postpartum hemorrhage
finding: Substantial misclassification exists in the diagnosis of atonic postpartum hemorrhage, which could contribute to the observed increase in postpartum hemorrhage rates.
mod_finding: Cases had higher rates of uterotonic use compared to controls, while delayed cord clamping was less common in cases who delivered vaginally.
